objective: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of Stormwind.

description: I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth.  The Eyes were crafted by Human Priests, so you'll have to go to Stormwind to find someone who can help you.  Speak with Archbishop Benedictus.  He is head of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.  He can help.
progress: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.
completion: An Eye of Paleth. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.
Let me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.
